reviews.title: Asrock Intel Arc B570 mid-range beast!
reviews.comment:
Works well for a mid-tier system! After installing the graphics card please do yourself a favor and download intel graphics software, go to the graphics settings and turn on the “Precompiled Shaders (Beta)” switch. This fixed all my issues I had with call of duty having stuttering issues in the middle of the game. Here is my systems specifications with the B570:
• CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X3D
• GPU: ASRock Intel Arc B570
• Motherboard: ASRock B550 Phantom Gaming-ITX/AX
• RAM: 32GB Corsair Vengeance DDR4 CL16
• Storage: 1TB NVMe SSD
• Case: Jonsbo Z20 orange/black
• Power Supply: ASUS ROG Loki SFX-L 750W
• CPU Cooler: Thermalright AXP90-X53 Full Copper
• Case Fans: 3x Noctua NF-A14 PWM, 1x Noctua NF-A12x15 PWM, 1x Thermalright TL-C12C X5
Runs great with Call of Duty on my 1440p monitor. I let the shaders run and left the graphics as such. I can probably do some more tweaking to get more frames but so far I am happy with what I am seeing. I really don’t play many games but I plan on doing some video editing using CapCut as well as music production with FL Studio.

reviews.title: Excellent for the price
reviews.comment: So far so good - have been able to play 7 days to Die, Path of Exile, Kingdom Come: Deliverance, Far Cry 5... and several other steam games with no problems.  There was a problem with 7  Days to Die crashing and restarting the computer due to a conflict with the anti-cheat software.  After I removed the video card software and motherboard software the crashes stopped.  So I am not sure what the exact problem was.  If you are looking for a good mid-range video this should fit the bill.
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.title: Solid for the most part
reviews.comment: When it works it’s amazing, occasional issues but nothing unable to be solved, I am using it on a Prime a320m-k, had to enable 4g and rebar, two issues, one with streaming on discord with hardware acceleration on, and another reoccuring issue is with the a blue screen code “Driver_IRQL” followed by some code, it seems to be driver/vram related, however it’s as simple as resetting the bios through clearing the CMOS, with the gpu removed and re-enabling 4g/Rebar, then replacing the B570, it crushes Vrchat (only works through wireless/virtual desktop due to compatibility issues), Avatar FoP, Palworld, all on high settings, no issue, as long as you have a cpu that can keep up, I use a Ryzen 5 5500 and I’d say thats the bare minimum pairing for this GPU, all in all if you’re patient enough, go for it.
